Can be fun but often the RNG just feels rigged. Also, there are Pay-To-Win elements in this game. If you don't spend in-game currency on an gold/diamond weapon and you're matched with someone who has one, you're already at a disadvantage and the percentage of you winning the match is greatly decreased. Obtaining enough in-game currency can be difficult and often a grind and actually based quite highly on luck. To top it off, in ym opinion, the prices of in-game currency is unreasonable. Edit: Having spent several more hours on this game after writing my initial review, I have decided alter this from a 3 star rating to a 1 star rating. There is a point (approximately 3200 trophies) in the game where you just cannot compete against other playing who have paid for gold/diamond weapons. You will consistently lose. I have no problems spending money on games I enjoy but unfortunately this game is too unbalanced and ultimately I've come to hate it.

Matches Master is one of the most unbalanced and biased puzzle games I've played. The gameplay feels fundamentally unfair. Many levels rely on randomness that consistently disadvantages the player, making progress feel more like luck than skill. The game often withholds the pieces you need, creates forced failures, and pushes you toward microtransactions. A good puzzle game challenges you; this one stacks the deck against you. Until the developers address these issues, it's hard to recommend.
